snippet.title: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store! | Announcement Trailer | Cozy Organizing Game
snippet.description:
Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store! is a new cozy organizing game coming to Steam. You shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical clothing store, one shelf at a time.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5285160/Silk_Collector_Tidy_Up_the_Clothing_Store/

This is a first-person cleaning and sorting game set in a three-floor fashion house. Every piece of clothing has a labeled shelf. Read the icon, check the size, find the section. Sorting clothes by color and size slowly turns a messy store into a tidy one, and watching the shelves fill up is where the satisfaction comes from. Every shelf you fill leaves silk behind. Spend it on magic spells that speed up the organizing. Some clothes wander the store like ghosts, and catching them can drop keys for the locked cabinets.

If you are looking for cozy games like Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!, Shelves and Sorcery, Witch Cabin Cleanup or Cellar Keeper, Silk Collector brings the same tidying loop to a clothing store. It also fits fans of organizing games like Unpacking and A Little to the Left, and anyone searching for cleaning simulator games, satisfying sorting games or new cozy games on Steam in 2026. It is made by the team behind Tailor Simulator, so if you enjoyed running a tailor shop, this is our next cozy fashion game.

Demo coming October 2026.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5285160/Silk_Collector_Tidy_Up_the_Clothing_Store/
Website: https://silkcollector.com
Discord: https://discord.gg/JN2K8CzRUu

Music: "Frost Waltz" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), used in this trailer
